maya (partnerships): Quick sync — NovaEdge joint perf/W + throughput bench. Goal: marketplace listing + SI playbook timed with announcement. Who owns the kernel tuning artifacts?
li (NovaEdge): We can provide kernel patches + power telemetry hooks. Need an NDA addendum for binary traces. available next week.
sam (eng-ml): For benchmarking, we prefer runs with: 1) FP16/4bit quant + kernel-tuned matmul, 2) batch sizes [1,4,8], 3) perf/W with synthetic workload and a real LLM trace. I'll drop a minimal run script.
sam (eng-ml): ```bash
python bench.py --model redwood-v1 --seq 1024 --batch 4 --quant 4 --trace sample.json
```
li (NovaEdge): That script looks fine. We'll instrument CPU power sensor and add our GPU power hooks. Can we align on SLO: 95th p99 latency < 120ms for batch=1?
maya (partnerships): p99 <120ms is ambitious but okay for the release candidate. We'll mark a canary on marketplace listing so customers see expected latency.
jit (product): What's the launch window? Legal & marketing need two weeks after final data.
maya (partnerships): Proposed timeline: bench runs + tune by Mar 30, integration + docs April 10, joint blog & marketplace listing April 24.
nora (legal): NDA addendum approved in principle. Send redacted sample traces only to partners until final sign-off.
bench-bot: scheduled run 2026-03-26T08:00Z for commit a3f2b1 — results will post to /bench-results/novaedge/aurora-perfw.json :eyes: 
li (NovaEdge): We'll sync infra: provide a consolidated perf/W CSV and kernel diff. Can one of you own the repo for artifacts?
sam (eng-ml): I'll open a repo under redwood/partner-bench/novaedge and add a README with run commands + expected metrics.
maya (partnerships): Perfect. Action items: @sam create repo + runbook; @li send kernel diffs + power hooks; @nora confirm trace redaction; @jit confirm internal comms schedule. Check-ins weekly on Wednesdays. :calendar: 
li (NovaEdge): Acknowledged. Thanks all — will send first diffs by EOD Tue. :thumbsup:
